$comment: Architecture candidate only. Schema validation is followed by typed range, cross-field and authority validation. Not a public v1 SDK.

BoundedUntrustedJson.description: Purpose-specific untrusted JSON: at most512KiB,depth64,nodes10000; descriptor payloads additionally require declared schema validation before use. Not an operation or authority escape hatch.

Counter.description: Canonical decimal 0..9223372036854775807. Typed range validation required.

Revision.description: Positive signed-64-bit counter; typed upper-bound validation required.

SavedCommandInput.description: Closed selected-operation argument object, bounded by the existing 1MiB/100-container frame ceiling; no aggregate DynamicJson node limit. The actual selected admission rechecks operation schema, inner JSON bounds and authority. Outer proposal framing remains unchanged.

schemaRevision.description: Negotiated operation schema revision. Absent means 1. Only revisions the selected operation registers are admitted; any other is UnsupportedSchema before authority.
